config.notes: TAFE Queensland course pages (tafeqld.edu.au/course/<n>/<id>/<slug>), one course per page, text only (no page data). Intakes: each offering panel prints "START DATE ... 25 Jan 2027 ... Workload ... Full time"; only full-time offerings are read (student-visa study is full time). Fee: only higher-education pages (associate degrees, bachelors, graduate certificates/diplomas, masters) print an international annual indicative fee (offering panel: "International: $27,600 This is an indicative fee for one year of full-time study for international students"); VET pages print a total course fee ("This is the total course fee for international students") which is deliberately NOT read. IELTS: "IELTS (Academic): 6.0" on higher-education pages only; VET English is central: https://tafeqld.edu.au/content/dam/tafe/en/documents/pdfs/international-students/TAFE%20Queensland_EnglishLanguageEquivalenciesTable.pdf. International intakes and VET totals: https://tafeqld.edu.au/international/courses/international-pricelist. Key dates: https://tafeqld.edu.au/international/how-to-apply/application-process/key-dates Delivery (mode) is read from the comparison-chart rows priced "International: $" (study mode label such as "On campus with some online" / "On Campus"), not from the WAYS TO STUDY summary, which mixes domestic ways (online, apprenticeships, TAFE at School).
